statement: Build a one-page website for Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, showing the menu with prices, opening hours, location, a pre-order option and a map of the three farms, with a warm feel and no photographs.
audience: Local customers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, who want to check the menu, prices, hours and location, pre-order, and learn where the ingredients come from.
standards: Single file of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step; CDN libraries allowed.
Warm feel achieved without photographs: warm colour palette, friendly typography, SVG or CSS illustration and texture.
Readable and usable on a phone screen as well as a desktop.
Every missing fact is shown as a visibly marked placeholder, never an invented value.
rules: Use no photographs: no img elements or CSS backgrounds pointing to photo files or photo URLs.
Do not invent prices, hours, phone numbers, street address, pre-order destination or farm coordinates.
Farm coordinates live in one clearly labelled data block so they can be filled in without changing the page structure.
Keep everything the brief asks for on a single page.
done_when: The file is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, and needs no build step.
The page shows the name Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
A menu section lists items with a price slot for each; any price not supplied is marked as a placeholder.
An hours section is present; any hours not supplied are marked as a placeholder.
A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a marked placeholder for the street address.
A pre-order section has a form with fields for name, item, quantity and pickup time, and a marked placeholder for where orders are sent.
A farm section contains a map container with three farm entries in one labelled data block, each marked as awaiting coordinates, and no invented coordinates.
The file contains no img elements and no photo file or photo URL references.
A warm palette is defined (for example as CSS variables) and used across the page, with at least one non-photo decorative element such as SVG or CSS art.
The page includes a viewport meta tag and a responsive layout rule for narrow screens.
Every placeholder is visibly marked on the page and listed in a single comment block in the file.
open_inputs: Where pre-orders are sent (phone, WhatsApp, email or other)
Coordinates and names of the three farms (promised next week)
